text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — during today's NREL onboarding call they raised 3 persistent asks: 1) per-route cost spikes when using embeddings, 2) embedding freshness (stale vectors), 3) rollout visibility for model pinning. This feels like a renewal risk if unaddressed.
omar: Thanks, Elaine. Can you paste the raw notes here?
elaine: sure — pasted the snippets from the call:
```
- "We can't explain why costs jump on particular routes; need per-customer/per-route breakdowns"
- "Embeddings we uploaded show old docs; search results stale by ~24-48h"
- "We need a predictable way to pin model versions during testing windows"
```
maria: tagging @jun for backend visibility — embeddings TTL probably on our ingest pipeline. :thinking_face: 
jun: saw similar from Acme last month. Likely two issues: 1) stale index job schedule (cron overlap) 2) cache key mismatch after bulk reingest. I'll run a quick grep on the ingest logs.
jun: fyi I've filed a short issue: https://internal/rdw/issue/CS-5242 — will update with logs.
elaine: perf: NREL said if we can't show per-route costs within 2 weeks they'll escalate renewal talk. high priority.
omar: proposal: bucket these into Ask-Hopper tags: COST_VIS, EMB_FRESH, PINNING. Agree? :white_check_mark:
maria: +1. Recommend quick mitigations: show a temporary per-route CSV export from billing data, bump reindex cadence for the affected customer, and document a manual pinning guide in the console.
elaine: else: @jun can you confirm reindex cadence change won't blow infra? :grimacing: 
jun: quick check: bump from 24h -> 6h for this customer should be safe for a week. I'll add a rate-limit flag.
triage-bot: New task created CS-5242 -> Engineering backlog. Priority: p1-customer-impact.
omar: I'll own the customer comms and the short-term dashboard export. Elaine — can you draft the message to share the temporary CSV and the workaround for pinning?
elaine: drafting now — will include sample CSV and step-by-step. putting in #cs-docs repo.
elaine: sample CSV export (heads-up format):
```
customer_id,route,period,tokens,usd_cost
nrel-001,search,2025-03-04,11234,12.48
nrel-001,chat,2025-03-04,5432,6.03
```
omar: nice. Let's reconvene Friday EOD for status. If engineering confirms reindex safe, we'll push the temporary export and a FAQ entry.
maria: leaving a note: longer-term we should add per-route cost attribution to Redwood Console (Metrics -> Per-route). Could we spike that as an Optimize project?
jun: agree. I'll attach logs and an initial runbook in the ticket.
elaine: thanks everyone. tagging follow-ups: @omar will send comms, @jun infra change, @maria docs/FAQ. :raised_hands:
